supersedes.reason: Owner-authorized one-shot closure: global agent behavior + full native 8 host + live release. New phase supersedes the full-native plan and inherits all still-valid requirements.

intent_reference.summary: One-shot Closure: Global Agent Behavior + Full Native 8 Host + Live Release

intent.outcome: Global agent behavior as ONE canonical runtime across all hosts/projects with full native 8-host install/reload/readback/rollback, real live evidence, single-writer run state, single outcome reducer, and a green release committed and pushed to GitHub with Quality + Certification of the exact commit ending success.
in_scope: Unified global-behavior runtime: 11 owner modules, single flow
Single vocabulary and naming; remove ambiguous/duplicate modules
5 rules groups with legacy parity matrix; purge modes
Skill lifecycle: SKILL.md canonical, 34 global skills, positive/negative routing
RunStore single writer + OutcomeReducer single reducer
Commit on main, push origin main, wait for Quality + Certification success
non_goals: No new synthetic modes or profiles
No reading/requesting credentials; use existing sessions only
No force-push; no reset/redo of dirty worktree
No parallel competing phases; one active pointer only
No long-lived compatibility facades beyond a tested migrator

assumptions.text: Authorized to commit and push directly to main
Antigravity is currently logged-in; model-turn live is mandatory
Cursor/Grok are signed-out; MODEL_BEHAVIOR=NEEDS_USER, host only OFFLINE_VERIFIED

decisions.statement: Single unified global-behavior runtime in canonical kernel with the single flow RequestIntake → PlanCompiler → ContextRuntime → SkillResolver → CapabilityBroker → ExecutionCoordinator → ProofRouter → RunStore → OutcomeReducer; orchestrated by BehaviorRuntime; HostAdapter for host edges.
decisions.rationale: One runtime to rule all hosts/projects; no per-batch prompt behavior.

decisions.statement: Remove/merge ambiguous names: Decision Fabric, Decision Closure, Planner Runtime, duplicate closure-*, context-*, routing paths; no long-lived facade/alias beyond a tested migrator.
decisions.rationale: Eliminate parallel truth paths and hard-coded verifier shortcuts.

decisions.statement: Use distinct field names per domain: task_state, claim_outcome, host_state, provider_state; remove ambiguous synonyms.
decisions.rationale: Stop conflating hundreds of status labels.

decisions.statement: Keep exactly 5 rules groups with legacy behavior→replacement→proof parity; parity index in Git history, no rule copies in archive.
decisions.rationale: Restore lost invariants without re-bloating to 13 rules.

decisions.statement: SKILL.md is the canonical skill authority; ROUTE.json removed from canonical role; catalog/host projection generated.
decisions.rationale: Single-source skills; deterministic routing from trigger facts.

decisions.statement: Core install never installs or enables MCP; agent-rules-mcp-bridge removed from all host configs; integration is the only enable/disable path.
decisions.rationale: Decouple MCP from core; preserve user MCP servers.

decisions.statement: HostAdapter is the single native contract: detect/inventory/planInstall/install/reload/readback/offlineCanary/authenticatedCanary/rollback/uninstall; provenance required; UNSUPPORTED/BLOCKED when no native surface.
decisions.rationale: Real native surfaces only; no invented mechanisms to fill 8 green cells.

decisions.statement: RunStore is the single writer of run/plan/evidence/result; OutcomeReducer is the single creator of final outcomes.
decisions.rationale: Workers never author PASS; closure derives from verifier evidence.

decisions.statement: Public CLI keeps exactly 8 commands: install, uninstall, doctor, status, run, integration, init, reference; status --details and --json for detail; doctor all --json machine-readable; integration only list|enable|disable|doctor.
Clone new phase only as active pointer; supersede prior phase without keeping two sources of truth.
decisions.rationale: One active plan source; the contract is the single executable plan.

requirements.summary: Semantic admission: 100% of requirements have full chain raw intent→requirement→claim→acceptance→task→owner→output→verifier→evidence→rollback; unresolved=[] before execution.
requirements.statement: Build the new phase plan with complete requirement mapping and worker packets; any owner-decided fact not yet resolved → NEEDS_USER.

requirements.summary: Take over the dirty worktree without reset/redo: full manifest of tracked/staged/unstaged/untracked; trace back from the pre-cut commit.
requirements.statement: Manifest all files, compare Git history/rules/profile/archive/runtime/host projections; produce legacy behavior→replacement→proof table.

requirements.summary: Unified global-behavior runtime: 11 owner modules with single flow; no module writes PASS or its own state.
requirements.statement: Implement BehaviorRuntime, RequestIntake, PlanCompiler, ContextRuntime, SkillResolver, CapabilityBroker, ExecutionCoordinator, ProofRouter, RunStore, OutcomeReducer, HostAdapter as canonical owners wired in the single flow.

requirements.summary: Remove or merge ambiguous/duplicate module names (Decision Fabric, Decision Closure, Planner Runtime, multiple closure-*, context-*, routing paths).
requirements.statement: Delete or merge duplicate modules; no long-lived facade/alias beyond a tested migrator.

requirements.summary: Single vocabulary per domain: task_state DISCUSSING|PLANNED|EXECUTING|VERIFYING|COMPLETE|BLOCKED|NEEDS_USER; claim_outcome PASS|PARTIAL|BLOCKED|UNSUPPORTED|PRE-EXISTING|NEEDS_USER; host_state NOT_DETECTED|DETECTED|INSTALLED|OFFLINE_VERIFIED|LIVE_VERIFIED|FAILED; provider_state UNAVAILABLE|AVAILABLE|AUTHORIZED|ACTIVE|FAILED.
requirements.statement: Enforce the four vocabulary fields; remove ambiguous synonyms.

requirements.summary: Keep exactly 5 rules groups covering (1) intent/authority/scope/safety, (2) planning/delegation/reconcile/anti-loop, (3) proof/acceptance/outcome, (4) context/skills/tools/communication, (5) maintainer/native/release; restore lost invariants; parity matrix proves old behavior replacements.
requirements.statement: Rules file 00-intent-scope-safety, 10-execution-planning-delegation, 20-proof-outcome, 30-context-skill-mcp, 40-maintainer; add parity matrix; procedural detail lives in runtime/skills.

requirements.summary: Delete completely vibe-coder, plain-vietnamese, technical_explain, operator-profile command/runtime/test remnants and all automation/docs referencing these modes; no replacement modes.
requirements.statement: Remove mode residue everywhere; communication default natural outcome-first.

requirements.summary: ContextCapsule contains raw request ref, effective requirements/decisions, current plan/task id, owned/forbidden scope, skill route receipt, capability plan/lease, evidence refs, remaining work and next action.
requirements.statement: Worker opens from plan artifact with no conversation; compaction does not lose intent/requirements/skills/MCP/proof; resume from canonical capsule; prompt classified compatible|refinement|conflict|supersedes|unrelated.

requirements.summary: Skill lifecycle: SKILL.md canonical for activation class, deterministic trigger facts, negative triggers, capabilities, dependencies, explicit-only policy, provider requirements, rollback, eval status; ROUTE.json removed from canonical; exactly 34 global skills source/install hash parity; per-skill positive and negative route test; key workflow skills have live behavior canary.
requirements.statement: 34 global skills (excluding 2 5fedu domain-pack skills); no second resolver path; installed hash parity; explicit user-invoked skill wins.

requirements.summary: MCP lifecycle: core install never installs/enables MCP; remove agent-rules-mcp-bridge from all host configs; preserve user MCP servers; integration is the only enable/disable path; MCP claim PASS requires 7-point canary; tasks without MCP prove no lease and no MCP call.
requirements.statement: Implement MCP lifecycle with handshake/listTools/tool-call nonce/effect/teardown/byte-rollback; use temp MCP canary only.

requirements.summary: Native 8-host HostAdapter: detect/inventory/planInstall/install/reload/readback/offlineCanary/authenticatedCanary/rollback/uninstall; registry does not self-declare native; provenance required; UNSUPPORTED/BLOCKED if no official surface; atomic+idempotent, zero-diff reinstall, byte-equal rollback, ownership-hash managed blocks only; candidate digest covers tracked+staged+unstaged+untracked.
requirements.statement: Implement HostAdapter contract for codex/claude/opencode/cursor/antigravity/grok/deepseek-harness/command-code with per-host native provenance and auth boundary.

requirements.summary: Proof/closure: RunStore single writer; OutcomeReducer single reducer; evidence contains exact command/API/tool call, redacted args, exit code/result, hashes, timestamp, host/native surface, pre/post bytes, source/candidate digest, claim/acceptance refs.
requirements.statement: Route all writes through RunStore; OutcomesReducer derives final results; direct filesystem writes from other runtime removed.

requirements.summary: Generated behavior-index: generated/behavior-index.json and generated/behavior-index.md with 10 canonical views; CLI reads the same index (status summary, status --details, doctor all --json).
requirements.statement: Generate the canonical index with all 10 views; never hand-edit generated/.

requirements.summary: Public CLI exactly 8 commands: install, uninstall, doctor, status, run, integration, init, reference; integration list|enable|disable|doctor; remove obsolete command modules/tests/aliases; docs/artifacts match.
requirements.statement: Enforce strict 8-command surface and integration subcommands.

requirements.summary: Finite coverage matrix: lifecycle stage × invariant × actor/handoff × success/failure/resume × affected host; every cell behavior+proof, not-applicable+reason, or blocked/needs-user+authority.
requirements.statement: Freeze the finite coverage matrix; new findings in covered cells are regressions; new real requests are future scope.

requirements.summary: Deterministic tests cover schema/semantic admission, trace chains, state transitions, single writer/atomic update, candidate digest change, stale/foreign evidence rejection, rules legacy parity + zero dead refs, skill hash parity, positive/negative routing, host adapter merge/idempotence/rollback/ownership, MCP lifecycle/teardown, 8-command CLI, and verify:all does not print failed-check then return success.
requirements.statement: Add deterministic tests covering all listed invariants.

requirements.summary: Process-level integration tests (12): two competing processes single-writer lock; kill-mid-transaction resume; context checkpoint→restart→capsule; plan-only handoff loads skills; scope conflict blocked; reconcile classified; skill resolver once per context generation; capability lease (MCP yes/no); MCP canary handshake/list/call; native installer on temp home + byte-equal rollback; packaged CLI loads runtime not source; hard-coded PASS verifier fails mutation test.
requirements.statement: Implement the 12 process-level integration tests.

requirements.summary: 14 live host journeys JOURNEY-001..014 executed on real hosts as specified.
requirements.statement: Run the 14 journeys and record evidence; JOURNEY-011 Antigravity logged-in model turn; JOURNEY-012 Cursor/Grok NEEDS_USER.

requirements.summary: Deliver 10 artifacts: baseline-and-loss-map, behavior-contract (coverage matrix/state vocab/module ownership), executable-plan (100% mapping + worker packets), behavior-index (json+md), native-host-matrix (8 hosts provenance/offline/live/rollback), skill-matrix (34 skills routing/eval/install hash), capability-matrix (skill/MCP/tool selection + live effects), evidence-ledger (source-bound raw observations), result.json (OutcomeReducer only), release-report (local gates/shas/workflows).
requirements.statement: Produce all 10 deliverables into RunStore.

requirements.summary: Local release gate runs in order: npm ci, npm run build, npm run check, npm test, npm run verify:all, packaged runtime lifecycle smoke, global behavior integration suite, native install/readback/rollback for 8 hosts, logged-in live canaries, security review, quality hard-block review, independent acceptance audit.
requirements.statement: Run the 12-step local release gate; verify:all must not print failed-check then success.

requirements.summary: Fix CI: declare tsx as direct root devDependency locked in lockfile; certification matrix uses all 8 hosts from canonical registry (not hard-coded 5); check runner per host label not any-runner; RUNNERS_UNAVAILABLE written as structured evidence without exit 78 reddening workflow; green workflow means pipeline+evidence integrity only; quality reads active current pointer not hard-coded V3.1/ledger; active plan/closure check fails hard; hosted CI recomputes source digest and confirms local native receipts bound to candidate; Quality and Certification workflows of push end success.
requirements.statement: Apply all CI fixes and confirm final workflows success.

requirements.summary: Cleanup and release: remove runtime residue/fake receipts/stale plans/dead rules/obsolete commands/managed MCP bridge; git status clean of out-of-scope files; commit directly on main with message 'feat: close global behavior and native host runtime'; push origin main (no force); wait for all workflows of the exact commit SHA; final report proves HEAD==origin/main==workflow SHA, clean status, Quality success, Certification success, 8-host offline matrix, live model matrix with Antigravity PASS and signed-out NEEDS_USER.
requirements.statement: Release to GitHub with exact-commit workflow success.

No invented native surface to fill 8 green cells
No force-push, no reset of dirty worktree
migration_constraints: One tested migrator for old artifacts then hard cut
Legacy rule/behavior parity mapping before deletion
Candidate digest includes untracked production bytes
